title: The SSF conformance PR added GET/PATCH/PUT stream handlers plus stream verify and status views without the add_stream provider permission check that the existing POST handler enforces, so any token holder for the app can read, modify, verify and disable its event streams.

findings.explanation: The code uses Django ORM filter() with dynamic field names constructed from provider_type._meta.model_name, but this is safe because model_name is a trusted Django metadata attribute, not user input. The f-string construction f"{provider_type._meta.model_name}__isnull" uses Django's ORM which parameterizes queries internally.

No SQL injection vectors present. The code uses Django ORM methods (filter, exists, delete) with trusted model attributes. The stream_uuid parameter is a UUID type and is used safely with ORM filters. No raw SQL or string concatenation into queries.

SSFStreamViewSet now includes DestroyModelMixin, enabling delete operations via the API. The viewset uses GenericViewSet without visible authorization checks in this diff. If the queryset Stream.objects.all() is not filtered by user/provider ownership, this could allow unauthorized deletion of streams (CWE-862). The test file suggests token-based auth is used, but no explicit permission/ownership checks are visible in the viewset itself.

evidence.content:
class SSFStreamViewSet(
    mixins.RetrieveModelMixin,
    mixins.DestroyModelMixin,
    mixins.ListModelMixin,
    GenericViewSet,
):
    """SSFStream Viewset"""

    queryset = Stream.objects.all()

findings.suggested_fix: Add permission_classes and/or override get_queryset() to filter streams by the authenticated user/provider. Ensure only authorized users can delete streams they own.

findings.explanation: The SSFStreamViewSet retrieves Stream objects using Stream.objects.all() without visible filtering by the authenticated user or application context. This creates potential for IDOR (CWE-639) if a user can request any stream UUID via the RetrieveModelMixin. The test file shows token-based auth, but there's no evidence of ownership validation in the viewset.

evidence.content:
class SSFStreamViewSet(
    mixins.RetrieveModelMixin,
    mixins.DestroyModelMixin,
    mixins.ListModelMixin,
    GenericViewSet,
):
    """SSFStream Viewset"""

    queryset = Stream.objects.all()
    serializer_class = SSFStreamSerializer

findings.suggested_fix: Override get_queryset() to filter Stream objects by the authenticated user's associated providers or applications. Verify that accessed streams belong to the authenticated user's scope.
